title: DC-Harness .harness/config.json
description: Documentation and editor autocomplete only; nothing validates this at runtime. See docs/contracts.md §1.

stack.description: Stacks in this repo, in the order their checks run. Each is a folder in stacks/.

stackCommands.description: Per-stack overrides, keyed by stack name. A missing key uses stacks/<stack>/default.json; null or "" skips that check.

tests.description: In the 'affected' size, test file paths are appended to this command.

protectedBranches.description: Branches where /dc:start-task refuses. Bash glob patterns.

specApprovalPhrase.description: Phrases that approve spec.md. Exact match after trimming, ignoring case.

planApprovalPhrase.description: Phrases that approve plan.md. Exact match after trimming, ignoring case.

passThreshold.description: Passed when passed / total >= this share.

maxRetriesPerQuestion.description: Retries after the first wrong or 'not sure' answer.

prTextMaxChars.description: Hard limit on pr-text.md. Azure DevOps allows 4,000.
